title: What Does the AI Doctor Value? Auditing Pluralism in the Clinical Ethics of Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM decisions on a benchmark of 50 binary-choice clinical dilemmas to infer their priority distributions across four medical ethical principles (autonomy, beneficence, nonmaleficence, justice) using a logistic regression-based value attribution method, and comparing these profiles to a physician consensus to detect systematic value preferences or algorithmic monoculture.
